headline: Pansari Developers files AGM voting results
hook: Pansari Developers concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: Pansari Developers Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also filed the official voting results with the exchange. These documents confirm the outcomes of resolutions presented to shareholders during the meeting.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural update with no immediate impact on share price.
